SPEC_LINES: 10071-10105 (final DOC-C POST /api/auth/verify-otac route matrix; paragraph extraction)
SPEC_TEXT: POST /api/auth/verify-otac verifies one-time code and creates session. Its canonical error matrix includes 401 AUTH_INVALID, 401 AUTH_EXPIRED, 403 DEVICE_MISMATCH, 409 OTAC_LOCKED, 409 SESSION_REVOKED.
EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: A submitted OTAC that existed for the email/device binding but is expired returns HTTP 401 with canonical ErrorCode AUTH_EXPIRED.
Invalid non-expired codes continue to return AUTH_INVALID unless another higher-specificity canonical error applies.
Expired and invalid outcomes remain auditable as AUTH_VERIFY_FAILED.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Collapse an expired OTAC into NO_SESSION/AUTH_INVALID when expiry is observable from the fetched canonical OTAC records.
Change the expected error merely to match current implementation.
